description.en: A juicy beef patty with melted cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles, ketchup, and mustard on a sesame bun.
description.am: ጣፋጭ የበሬ ስጋ ከቀለጠ ቺዝ፣ ሰላጣ፣ ቲማቲም፣ ሽንኩርት፣ ኮሽሪ እና ማዮኔዝ ጋር በሰሳሚ ዳቦ የቀረበ።

description.en: A savory beef patty with smoky BBQ sauce, crispy onion rings, cheddar cheese, lettuce, and tomato on a toasted sesame bun.
description.am: ጣዕም ያለው የበሬ ስጋ ከቢቢኪው ሶስ፣ ክሪስፒ የሽንኩርት ቀለበት፣ ቺዝ እና ሰላጣ ጋር።

description.en: A tender grilled chicken breast, topped with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and mayo, served on a sesame bun.
description.am: ለስላሳ የተጠበሰ የዶሮ ጡት ከሰላጣ፣ ቲማቲም፣ ኮሽሪ እና ማዮኔዝ ጋር።

description.en: A classic Italian pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, basil leaves, and a drizzle of olive oil.
description.am: ክላሲክ የጣሊያን ፒዛ በቲማቲም ሶስ፣ ትኩስ ሞዛሬላ፣ ባሲል እና የወይራ ዘይት።

description.en: Grilled chicken pieces smothered in smoky BBQ sauce, with red onions, mozzarella, and cilantro on a tomato base.
description.am: የተጠበሰ የዶሮ ስጋ በቢቢኪው ሶስ፣ ቀይ ሽንኩርት፣ ሞዛሬላ እና ኮረሪማ በቲማቲም መሰረት።
